The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast investigates Britain’s “real X-Files” with police inspector and UFO researcher Roy Teague

What happens when the people reporting UFO encounters are trained police officers—professional witnesses accustomed to observing, assessing and documenting unusual events?

Listen to the INTERVIEW > https://open.spotify.com/episode/5BpdKwyHFgrXhPI04dPFUR

In an essential new episode of The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast, bestselling paranormal author and researcher G. L. Davies speaks with Inspector Roy Teague about the extraordinary testimony behind his book, Close Encounters of the Police Kind: Incredible True Stories of UFO Sightings by British Police Officers.

Teague served as a police officer for 26 years and has collected more than 250 accounts from officers reporting UFOs and other unexplained phenomena across Britain, dating back to the 1960s. Many remained silent for years, fearful that speaking publicly could damage their reputations and careers.

Their testimony raises an urgent question: if credible, highly trained observers are witnessing objects and events they cannot explain, why are these reports still being ignored?

In “Close Encounters of the Police Kind: The Real X-Files,” Davies takes listeners beyond sensational headlines to examine what officers claim to have witnessed while on duty. The discussion explores startling sightings, missing time, alleged abductions, and the culture of silence surrounding police UFO encounters.

CLICK BOOK COVER TO Read Roy Teague’s book: Close Encounters of the Police Kind: Incredible True Stories of UFO Sightings by British Police Officers

This is not simply another conversation about strange lights in the sky. It is an important examination of credible witnesses, professional stigma and evidence that may challenge everything we think we know about the skies above Britain.

Hosted by bestselling author G. L. Davies, The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast brings serious investigation, compelling testimony and fearless discussion to the world’s greatest unexplained mysteries.

Listen now—but prepare to question what may be operating above us.
